description.value: This study examines gray matter volume differences between cannabis-dependent individuals who do not smoke tobacco, cannabis-dependent individuals who smoke tobacco, cannabis-naïve nicotine-dependent individuals who smoke tobacco, and healthy controls using voxel-based morphometry.
